user.title: Battery
user.description: The entities Home Assistant already has for the battery, and the battery. The integration only reads them: it never drives the inverter or the battery.

data_description.soc_entity: The state of charge the battery's BMS reports (%). Its crossing of the empty threshold is the empty landmark.
data_description.power_entity: Optional: the battery's DC power (W or kW), positive while charging. With it, the flows are integrated from the power; it or both energy meters are needed.
data_description.invert_power: On when the inverter reports the battery's power positive while discharging.
data_description.charged_entity: Optional: a cumulative meter of the energy into the battery (DC; a daily meter is fine). With a power, it counts what the power missed while unavailable.
data_description.discharged_entity: Optional: a cumulative meter of the energy out of the battery (DC), with the energy in.
data_description.cell_voltage_entities: Optional: the highest cell voltage of each pack (V or mV). A cell at the full voltage is the full landmark; without them, the state of charge reaching 100 %.
data_description.nominal_capacity_kwh: The battery's capacity on its datasheet.
data_description.empty_soc_pct: The state of charge where the battery is taken as empty, usually where an automation switches the house to the grid.
data_description.full_cell_v: A cell at this voltage is the full landmark (3.50 V on LFP), when cell voltages are given.
data_description.efficiency_pct: What comes out of the battery for what went in (DC), until one is learned.
data_description.full_energy_kwh: Optional: the energy the battery delivers from full to the empty threshold. Without it, the nominal capacity above the empty threshold.
data_description.max_power_kw: A meter increase faster than this is a spurious value.
data_description.learn: Count the round trip and the energy between the landmarks learned on the cycles in place of the values above, from 3 cycles. Learned in any case (the diagnostic sensors).

reconfigure.title: Battery entities
reconfigure.description: The entities read. The battery's parameters and the estimate stay; replaced meters are counted from their first reading.

abort.already_configured: This state of charge already has a battery.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The battery now reads the new entities.

error.no_flow_source: Give the battery power or both energy meters: the integration counts the energy that flows in and out.
error.one_meter: Give both energy meters (in and out), or none.
error.full_energy_above_capacity: The energy between the landmarks cannot exceed the nominal capacity.

mark_full.name: Mark full
mark_full.description: The battery is full now: the counting restarts from there (nothing is learned from it).

mark_empty.name: Mark empty
mark_empty.description: The battery is at its empty threshold now.

set_energy.name: Set energy
set_energy.description: Sets the energy the battery can still deliver above its empty threshold.

missing_soc_entity.title: The state of charge of {name} no longer exists
missing_soc_entity.description: The state of charge {entity} of the battery {name} no longer exists (renamed, or its device removed): the empty landmark is no longer seen. To choose its replacement or remove it, reconfigure the battery: *Settings* > *Devices & services* > *Smart Hass - Battery* > ⋮ > *Reconfigure*.

missing_power_entity.title: The battery power of {name} no longer exists
missing_power_entity.description: The battery power {entity} of the battery {name} no longer exists (renamed, or its device removed): the flows are counted by the energy meters if any, else the stored energy is unavailable. To choose its replacement or remove it, reconfigure the battery: *Settings* > *Devices & services* > *Smart Hass - Battery* > ⋮ > *Reconfigure*.

missing_charged_entity.title: The energy in meter of {name} no longer exists
